q: The invariance theorem for Kolmogorov complexity states that for any two universal Turing machines U and V:
opts: |K_U(x) - K_V(x)| ≤ c_{UV} for all x (additive constant independent of x)
K_U and K_V coincide only for short strings
exp: The invariance theorem: |K_U(x) - K_V(x)| ≤ c where c depends on U,V but not on x. This makes Kolmogorov complexity 'machine-independent' up to an additive constant — it is a well-defined property of the string, not the machine.
